** Afternoon Delight: Weird Barbie’s Beach Day!
------------------------------------------------------------


** Saturday, August 8, 12pm-8pm | Oakland
------------------------------------------------------------

Weird Barbie is back for another poolside beach adventure. She’s calling all the Barbies, Kens, and Stacies to join her - even Service Sub Allen is getting in on the fun!

Nurse Barbie? Check!

Thick thighs Barbie? Check!

Bondage hood Ken? Mmmmph!

Which Barbie, Ken, or even Allen are you? What attribute, occupation, kink, fetish, or desire wants to be represented? Even more fun, how many different ones can you represent over the course of the party? We’re taking playing dress-up to the next level - just like Weird Barbie would want for us!

Open To: Members Only

Parties, potlucks, and special members-only offers are only available to Bonobo Network members. We would love to see you at all of our upcoming gatherings! ** Queergasm Presents Unholy Sunday
------------------------------------------------------------


** Sunday, August 16, 12pm-8pm | Oakland
------------------------------------------------------------

Join us for an afternoon of sacred mischief, radical consent, and unapologetic pleasure… a poolside temple built for the queer, the curious, and the gloriously unholy.

Our sacraments will include a consent workshop (learn your yes and nos), the laying on of hands (sensual massage), the binding of the willing (shibari), and communion at the dessert bar. We'll have DJs spinning up sinfully delicious beats that you won't be expected to resist.

Bonobo Network membership isn’t required for this event. You just need to identify as queer or questioning, and if you’re not a Bonobo member you must attend with a PAL (Pervy Activity Liaison).

A PAL is not necessarily a date – it has to be someone you know who you would be willing to vouch for, and vice versa. PALs provide social support for one another, as well as mutual accountability to the norms of the space we're creating together. PALs must arrive at the party together and leave the party together. So for instance, if one person is asked to leave for any reason, their PAL(s) must leave with them.

Non-members who arrive without a PAL will not be allowed entry and your ticket will not be refunded.

>>> MEET YOUR NEW HOSTS!

Chris Logan (he/him) is a relationship coach, community organizer and lifelong overthinker who has spent most of his life helping people feel less alone in life's circumstances. He's queer, spiritually restless, and thriving on his way to living his best life. You can find out more at https://livingtender.coach/?mc_cid=4aaa42a116&mc_eid=UNIQID

Andrea (she/they) is a Colombiana who’s been in the Bay for nearly 15 years now. A lot of her community organizing has centered on restorative justice, community empowerment and building intentional communities- including multiple cooperatives. They’re particularly excited to build spaces that are community led and foster intersectionality.

Open To: All Bonobo Network members and non-members who arrive with a PAL
